check.population: every module whose behavior varies by mode, state, request kind or traversal
check.freshness: a verdict stands until the module's branching or its state model changes
check.refusal: the review or the complexity threshold rejects the change that reintroduces the branching the pattern removes
check.observation: conditional complexity and dispatch counts read from source, and the recorded design review
check.evidence: none: the catalog states this check as a class, so a watched run belongs to each system that adopts it
check.authority: the pattern's dispatch structure, which a change to the module's branching is compared against

distinctFrom.reason: A strategy replaces behavior behind one interface, while a decorator adds behavior by wrapping an object in the same interface.

records.name: Strategy Pattern
records.definition: A design pattern that puts each interchangeable algorithm behind one interface, so the caller selects behavior by passing an object.
detected_by: conditional strategy selection with duplicated behavior

records.name: Template Method Pattern
records.definition: A design pattern that fixes the steps of an algorithm in a base class and lets subclasses supply the steps that vary.

exemplar.before:
function importJsonFoo(raw: string) { validateJson(raw); return saveFoo(parseJson(raw)); }
function importCsvFoo(raw: string) { validateCsv(raw); return saveFoo(parseCsv(raw)); }

records.name: Observer Pattern
records.definition: A design pattern in which a subject publishes events to subscribers it does not know by name.

records.name: Mediator Pattern
records.definition: A design pattern that routes the interactions between a set of objects through one coordinating object.

exemplar.before:
fooEditor.notify(fooList, fooDetails, fooToolbar, foo);
fooList.update(fooDetails, fooToolbar, foo);

records.name: Command Pattern
records.definition: A design pattern that wraps a request in an object, so it can be queued, deferred or undone.
detected_by: switch/if chains selecting an operation to run

records.name: State Pattern
records.definition: A design pattern that gives each state of an object its own class, so behavior and legal transitions change with the state.
detected_by: repeated conditionals on a status field

records.name: Chain of Responsibility Pattern
records.definition: A design pattern that passes a request along an ordered list of handlers until one of them handles it.
detected_by: long if/else ladders handling heterogeneous requests

records.name: Iterator Pattern
records.definition: A design pattern that lets callers traverse a collection without seeing how it is stored.
detected_by: index/pointer traversal of another type's internals

exemplar.before: for (let i = 0; i < fooTree.nodes.length; i += 1) visit(fooTree.nodes[i]);

records.name: Visitor Pattern
records.definition: A design pattern that places each operation over a type hierarchy in its own visitor, so an operation is added without editing the element types.

records.name: Memento Pattern
records.definition: A design pattern in which an object captures its own state in an opaque snapshot it can later restore.

records.name: Null Object Pattern
records.definition: A design pattern that represents absence with an object implementing the expected interface as a no-op.
detected_by: repeated null checks before the same operation

exemplar.before:
const logger = config.logger;
if (logger) logger.info("foo saved");

records.name: Finite State Machine
records.definition: A conceptual representation of behavior as a closed set of states and the events that move between them.
detected_by: impossible or contradictory state combinations reachable at runtime

exemplar.before:
let isOpen = false, isLoading = false, isError = false;
function onClick() { isLoading = true; if (isOpen) isOpen = false; }

distinctFrom.reason: A finite state machine is flat states and events, while statecharts add nested states and parallel regions to it.

records.name: Statecharts
records.definition: A conceptual representation of a state machine extended with nested states and parallel regions.
detected_by: combinatorial state growth from independent concerns modeled in one flat machine
